title: I Reported the Gym Locker Cut With the Serial They Logged

parts.text: Someone snipped my lock. The desk said they had no way to know. I had logged the serial on the membership app like the orientation video said. I was thirty-four, standing in socks. They found the bolt cutters in the lost and found, tagged with a staff nickname. The nickname belonged to a trainer who "helped people who forgot combinations." My combination was not forgotten. The serial matched the log. They replaced the lock and walked the trainer. I put shoes on. Socks are a vulnerable state. Logs are not. I still gym there because the video told the truth once someone made it matter.

social.video_title: Lost and found had bolt cutters with a staff nickname — Part 1/1
social.description: Serial in the app, snipped lock, socks on tile. Would you have quit the gym that day?
